description: Find live software by keyword before building from scratch. Public, no sign-in needed. Returns descriptions, USD license prices, tech stacks and listing links. Example: {"search": "invoice", "limit": 5}. Empty search browses recent software. When hasMore is true without nextCursor, narrow the search. Matching is lexical. Errors set isError; retry a rate limit later. Use z2h_compare_marketplace_listings for a shortlist or z2h_show_marketplace for cards. A result does not guarantee suitability or purchase availability.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Keep the same filters and sort.

domains.description: Industry tags for the software. Choose keys from the Zero to Hundred taxonomy: ai, analytics, art-design, auth-identity, cms, conference, developer-tools, devops, e-commerce-marketplace, education, entertainment, environmental, fashion, finance, food, gaming, graphic-design, health, interior-design, marketing, membership, messaging, non-profit, political, productivity, real-estate, religious, services, social, technology, travel, ux-ui, wedding, other. Omission searches across industries.

limit.description: Number of listings to return in this page. Omission uses 20.

mode.description: Filter by the listing's sale model. Omission leaves the sale model unfiltered.

operatingStatus.description: Filter by software readiness or existing commercial operation, rather than listing publication state.

search.description: Keywords describing the software the Buyer needs.

sort.description: Result order. Defaults to relevance for a search, otherwise newest.

type.description: Categories matching the kind of software the Buyer wants. Omission searches across categories.

name: z2h_search_marketplace

hasMore.description: More matches exist. If nextCursor is null, narrow the search instead of paging.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null if cursor paging is unavailable or finished.

results.description: Live public software matching the filters.

licensePrice.description: Current USD license price, or null when unset.

listingUrl.description: Public listing page. Open it to review or purchase.

slug.description: Public identifier for comparison, display, and listing links.

searchMode.description: Text uses keyword matching, not semantic similarity.

title: Search marketplace software
